Density map

Source: R/express.R
px_density_map.Rd

In a density map, each row of data_frame contributes to the intensity of the color of the region around the corresponding point on the map.

Usage

px_density_map(
  data_frame = NULL,
  lat = NULL,
  lon = NULL,
  z = NULL,
  hover_name = NULL,
  hover_data = NULL,
  custom_data = NULL,
  animation_frame = NULL,
  animation_group = NULL,
  category_orders = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  color_continuous_scale = NULL,
  range_color = NULL,
  color_continuous_midpoint = NULL,
  opacity = NULL,
  zoom = NULL,
  center = NULL,
  map_style = NULL,
  radius = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  template = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

data_frame

A data.frame, data.table, list or matrix. Needed for column names to be used in the other arguments; if NULL, a data frame is built from the vectors given in the other arguments.

lat

A column name in data_frame, a vector of values, a one-sided formula evaluated in data_frame (e.g. ~ log(pop)), px_constant() or px_range(). Values from this column or vector are used to position marks according to latitude on a map.

lon

A column name in data_frame, a vector of values, a one-sided formula evaluated in data_frame (e.g. ~ log(pop)), px_constant() or px_range(). Values from this column or vector are used to position marks according to longitude on a map.

z

A column name in data_frame, a vector of values, a one-sided formula evaluated in data_frame (e.g. ~ log(pop)), px_constant() or px_range(). Values from this column or vector are used to position marks along the z axis in cartesian coordinates.

hover_name

A column name in data_frame, a vector of values, a one-sided formula evaluated in data_frame (e.g. ~ log(pop)), px_constant() or px_range(). Values from this column or vector appear in bold in the hover tooltip.

hover_data

Extra data to show in the hover tooltip: column names (a character vector or a formula such as ~c(a, b)), or a named list with column names as names and values TRUE (default formatting), FALSE (hide the column, e.g. one shown by default), a d3-format string such as ":.3f", a vector of data, or a list of a format string or TRUE and a vector of data.

custom_data

Column names (a character vector or a formula such as ~c(a, b)), or a list of column names, formulas and vectors. Values from these columns are added to the traces' customdata (e.g. for use in Shiny events) without appearing in the hover tooltip.

animation_frame

A column name in data_frame, a vector of values, a one-sided formula evaluated in data_frame (e.g. ~ log(pop)), px_constant() or px_range(). Values from this column or vector are used to assign marks to animation frames.

animation_group

A column name in data_frame, a vector of values, a one-sided formula evaluated in data_frame (e.g. ~ log(pop)), px_constant() or px_range(). Values from this column or vector are used to provide object-constancy across animation frames: rows with matching animation_groups will be treated as if they describe the same object in each frame.

category_orders

Named list mapping column names to the order of their values in axes, legends and facets, e.g. list(day = c("Thur", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")). By default values appear in the order first encountered, or in level order for factors.

labels

Named character vector or list mapping column names to the labels to use for axis titles, legend entries and hover text, e.g. c(gdpPercap = "GDP per capita").

color_continuous_scale

Character vector of colors, e.g. px_colors$sequential$Viridis, or the name of a scale in px_colors. Used when color is numeric. Defaults to the template's sequential colorscale.

range_color

If provided, overrides auto-scaling on the continuous color scale.

color_continuous_midpoint

If set, computes the bounds of the continuous color scale to have the desired midpoint. Setting this value is recommended when using plotly.express.colors.diverging color scales as the inputs to color_continuous_scale.

opacity

Value between 0 and 1. Sets the opacity for markers.

zoom

Between 0 and 20. Sets initial map zoom level. Higher values are more zoomed-in. If not provided, the map will select its own zoom level.

center

Dict keys are "lat" and "lon" Sets the center point of the map.

map_style

Identifier of base map style. Allowed values are "basic", "carto-darkmatter", "carto-darkmatter-nolabels", "carto-positron", "carto-positron-nolabels", "carto-voyager", "carto-voyager-nolabels", "dark", "light", "open-street-map", "outdoors", "satellite", "satellite-streets", "streets", "white-bg".

radius

Sets the radius of influence of each point.

title

The figure title.

subtitle

The figure subtitle.

template

A template name (see template_names()) or a template list. Defaults to default_template().

width

The figure width in pixels.

height

The figure height in pixels.

Value

A go_figure().

See also

Other plotly express: px_area(), px_bar(), px_bar_polar(), px_box(), px_choropleth(), px_choropleth_map(), px_density_contour(), px_density_heatmap(), px_ecdf(), px_funnel(), px_funnel_area(), px_histogram(), px_icicle(), px_imshow(), px_line(), px_line_3d(), px_line_geo(), px_line_map(), px_line_polar(), px_line_ternary(), px_parallel_categories(), px_parallel_coordinates(), px_pie(), px_scatter(), px_scatter_3d(), px_scatter_geo(), px_scatter_map(), px_scatter_matrix(), px_scatter_polar(), px_scatter_ternary(), px_strip(), px_sunburst(), px_timeline(), px_treemap(), px_violin()

Examples

px_data_carshare() |>
  px_density_map(lat = ~centroid_lat, lon = ~centroid_lon, z = ~car_hours, radius = 10)
